capabilities: Create a virtual note from the File Explorer right-click menu
Pick a destination folder for the new note
Embed the source note in the generated file
Add a numeric suffix when the target filename exists
disambiguation: Despite the name, it creates no frontmatter alias; the new note is just a file embedding the original.
extras: The README notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff and must be installed manually by copying the folder into .obsidian/plugins; no build step is needed.
intentEvidence: The generated note contains only an embed of the source, so the same content can appear in another folder
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to quickly surface one note's content in a second folder without duplicating the file or hand-writing an embed link.
summary: File Explorer command that creates a Markdown note containing only an embed of an existing note, so the same content appears in another folder.
